description: Deterministic renderer-compatibility inputs for the native Anime4K capability, catalog, and performance-protection hosted probe.
notes: The sole production provider ID is anime4k. The current production path supports Anime4K on a hardware OpenGL 4.3+ renderer with a 4096+ texture limit. Direct3D 11, Vulkan, Metal, software rendering, and insufficient OpenGL remain unsupported. Cases exercise only the active renderer API, OpenGL version, texture limit, and software-renderer classification. The capability result must not expose GPU adapter identity, hardware classification, or preset recommendation fields. The executable also links the production catalog resolver and performance-protection state machine; it never certifies a shader, GPU workload, displayed pixel, or native Present.
